hebrewText: וְ/אָדָ֣ם בִּ֭/יקָר בַּל יָלִ֑ין נִמְשַׁ֖ל כַּ/בְּהֵמ֣וֹת נִדְמֽוּ

tokens.bdb: ruddy i.e. a human being (an individual or the species, mankind, etc.)
tokens.kjv: [idiom] another, [phrase] hypocrite, [phrase] common sort, [idiom] low, man (mean, of low degree), person.
tokens.enLiteralWord: ruddy i.e. a human being (an individual or the species
tokens.explanation: adam — ser humano, homem, a humanidade como espécie
tokens.explanationEn: ruddy i.e. a human being (an individual or the species

tokens.bdb: value, i.e. (concretely) wealth; abstractly, costliness, dignity
properly, a failure; by implication nothing; usually (adverb) not at all; also lest
tokens.kjv: lest, neither, no, none (that...), not (any), nothing.

tokens.bdb: to stop (usually over night); by implication, to stay permanently; hence (in a bad sense) to be obstinate (especially in words, to complain)
tokens.kjv: abide (all night), continue, dwell, endure, grudge, be left, lie all night, (cause to) lodge (all night, in, -ing, this night), (make to) murmur, remain, tarry (all night, that night).

tokens.bdb: to liken, i.e. (transitively) to use figurative language (an allegory, adage, song or the like); intransitively, to resemble
tokens.kjv: be(-come) like, compare, use (as a) proverb, speak (in proverbs), utter.

tokens.bdb: properly, a dumb beast; especially any large quadruped or animal (often collective)
to be dumb or silent; hence, to fail or perish; trans. to destroy
tokens.kjv: cease, be cut down (off), destroy, be brought to silence, be undone, [idiom] utterly.
tokens.ptLiteralWord: to be dumb or silent; hence
tokens.enLiteralWord: to be dumb or silent; hence
tokens.explanation: to be dumb or silent; hence
tokens.explanationEn: to be dumb or silent; hence
